name: OpenLineage HTTP endpoint
summary: Send OpenLineage run events for every Ogun run to any OpenLineage-compatible HTTP endpoint, with Ogun facets for artifacts and windows.

fields.name: bearer_token
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: url
settings.label: Endpoint URL
settings.help: Base URL of the receiver. Nothing is sent until you set it. No user information in the URL.

settings.name: path
settings.label: Path
settings.help: Used when the URL has no path of its own.

settings.name: namespace
settings.label: Namespace
settings.help: OpenLineage namespace for Ogun jobs and datasets.

egress.note: The host of the url setting, on the port in the url. There is no default endpoint and no telemetry.

notes: Ogun sends OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets for artifacts and windows, one per request and in order, through an outbox (ADR 0012). The ogun-export sink delivers over http or https. The daemon's own outbox (O-05 section 5) reaches http:// endpoints only.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
